summary_en: Full-year dividend per share raised to 4.00 yen from 3.00 yen, comprising 3.00 yen ordinary dividend and 1.00 yen commemorative dividend for the company's 20th anniversary, for fiscal year ending June 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Full-Year Performance Forecasts and Revision of Dividend Forecasts (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Bushiroad Inc. announced on November 12, 2026 a revision of its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2027. The full-year dividend per share has been raised to 4.00 yen from the previously announced 3.00 yen. The new dividend consists of an ordinary dividend of 3.00 yen per share and a commemorative dividend of 1.00 yen per share marking the company's 20th anniversary.

This dividend increase accompanies an upward revision of full-year financial forecasts. Consolidated revenue is now projected at 71,000 million yen (up from 58,000 million yen), operating profit at 6,600 million yen (up from 5,300 million yen), ordinary profit at 7,100 million yen (up from 6,000 million yen), and profit attributable to parent company shareholders at 5,100 million yen (up from 4,200 million yen). Earnings per share are revised to 37.83 yen from 30.88 yen.

The company stated that shareholder profit returns remain a key management priority alongside building a stable financial base to support growth investments. The dividend revision was approved by the board of directors on November 12, 2026 and is scheduled for approval at the ordinary general meeting of shareholders in September 2027.
